mapper.sql: id,tenant_id AS tenantId,object_key AS objectKey,original_name AS originalName,mime_type AS mimeType,size_bytes AS sizeBytes,sha256,classification,institution_id AS institutionId,scan_status AS scanStatus,uploaded_by AS uploadedBy,etag,last_error AS lastError,expires_at AS expiresAt,created_at AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt,version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_file_object WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT FROM crm_file_object WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND object_key=#{objectKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_file_object SET scan_status='SCANNING',last_error=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND scan_status='PENDING'

UPDATE crm_file_object SET etag=#{etag},sha256=#{sha256},size_bytes=#{sizeBytes},mime_type=#{mimeType}, last_error=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND scan_status='SCANNING'

UPDATE crm_file_object SET object_key=#{objectKey},scan_status='CLEAN',last_error=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND scan_status=#{expectedStatus}
UPDATE crm_file_object SET scan_status=#{scanStatus},last_error=#{lastError},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND scan_status='SCANNING'
